name: Brazil
summary: Brazil combines territorial defence, autonomous governance, and women- and youth-led organising across Amazon and Quilombola territories.
featured_achievements: Government agencies removed intruders from the 152,000-hectare Ituna-Itata territory.
Quilombola youth and women leadership pipelines expanded through movement-building seminars.
Territorial fund strengthening advanced community-led finance in the Amazon and Babassu territories.

stories.title: Defending uncontacted territories in Ituna-Itata
stories.summary: Partners supported government action to remove illegal occupants from Ituna-Itata, a key uncontacted Indigenous territory.

stories.title: Youth leadership in Quilombola movements
stories.summary: The first Quilombola Youth Seminar strengthened intergenerational organising for legal recognition and territorial autonomy.

stories.title: COIAB territorial defence and monitoring in 2024
stories.summary: Partners advanced territorial expeditions and monitoring while engaging with public agencies on demarcation pathways.

stories.title: COP30 mobilisation from Amazon territories
stories.summary: Brazil-based partners prepared tenure and climate priorities for the COP30 cycle in Belem.

quote.text: Without Indigenous peoples protecting the forests and rivers, we won’t be able to survive much longer on this land.
